throughline.zh: 台灣供應商的日本設備服務與泰國材料用地進展，連同馬來西亞晶片發表及越南工廠設備合約，呈現設計、製造服務與終端建置各自不同的落地階段。
throughline.en: Taiwanese firms’ Japanese equipment-service and Thai materials-site plans, Malaysian chip launches and a Vietnamese factory-equipment contract show distinct implementation stages across design, manufacturing services and end-use facilities.

title.zh: 熊本晶圓計畫核准與台灣設備服務收購授權
title.en: Kumamoto fab approval and Taiwanese equipment-service acquisition authorization

summary.zh: 日本 10/16 核准 JASM 二廠變更計畫，台灣光罩同日改由母公司擬收購熊本 TCK。前者仍在建置，後者尚未確認交割，分別對應製程建置與在地設備服務。
summary.en: Japan approved JASM’s revised second-fab plan on October 16, while Taiwan Mask changed the proposed TCK buyer to the parent. Fab construction and unconfirmed acquisition closing represent separate process-build and local-service milestones.

title.zh: 馬來西亞六項晶片創新涵蓋儲存、工業控制與電源
title.en: Malaysia’s six innovations span storage, industrial control and power

summary.zh: 10/16 發表的六項創新包括 AI 處理器、儲存、FPGA、車用與衛星電源控制等。部長估計 3 億令吉合計銷售潛力但未列期間，客戶認證與量產數量仍待公布。
summary.en: The October 16 launches include AI processors, storage, FPGA and automotive/satellite power control. The minister’s RM300 million combined sales potential has no stated period, with customer qualification and production volumes undisclosed.

title.zh: 越南軋鋼產線核心設備合約落定
title.en: Vietnamese rolling line reaches core-equipment contract stage

summary.zh: VinMetal 與 Danieli 10/15 簽訂核心設備合約，專案位於河靜永安經濟區。逾 70 萬噸為單條產線年設計能力，交付、投產與客戶驗收時程尚未公布。
summary.en: VinMetal and Danieli signed the core-equipment contract on October 15 for Ha Tinh’s Vung Ang Economic Zone. Above 700,000 tonnes is one line’s annual design capacity; delivery, start-up and customer-acceptance schedules are undisclosed.

title.zh: 泰國材料用地與柔佛智慧園區分處規劃階段
title.en: Thai materials land and Johor smart campus remain planning-stage projects

summary.zh: 榮科 10/16 通過泰國子公司購地案，價款與廠址待定；同日報導 Genting 與華為規劃古來 430 英畝智慧園區。兩案均未提供可核實的新增量產、租戶或實付投資數字。
summary.en: LCY Technology approved Thai subsidiary land plans on October 16 with site and price pending; reports the same day described Genting and Huawei’s 430-acre Kulai campus plan. Neither provides verified new production, tenant or paid-investment figures.

title.zh: 越南提出 2027 成長目標與 2026 全年貿易估計
title.en: Vietnam sets 2027 targets and a 2026 full-year trade estimate

summary.zh: 越南政府 10/17 向國會提出次年 GDP 至少成長 10%、CPI 約 4.5% 及生產力成長 8.6% 目標。2026 年商品進出口估計 1.11 兆美元，目標與估計皆須與已完成實績分開閱讀。
summary.en: The government presented next-year targets to parliament on October 17: at least 10% GDP growth, CPI around 4.5% and 8.6% productivity growth. Estimated 2026 merchandise trade of US$1.11 trillion and the targets must be distinguished from completed results.
